gen-dafont-groovy-fs-erode: Groovy leans friendly and funky, its c nearly pinched shut and every arm drawn as one ribbon. And Erode, a text serif with a broad open a and g, swells and thins gently beneath it; try the heading big and the body modest.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-trench-slab: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy loosens its lowercase and lets its c nearly close. But Trench Slab, a text serif with almost no step from lowercase up to capitals, answers with a dignified, refined look; Groovy earns its place big and brief.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-fs-literata: Hammerhead's plain, unmodulated outline gives it an industrial, authoritative stance, with an e that never squeezes shut. Literata, a text serif with sturdy hairlines and wide curved mouths, brings the bookish side, and that pull between heavy plainness and refinement is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-fs-sentient: Sentient is a contemporary text serif with pinched apertures and crossbars a touch thinner than its stems, giving a sophisticated texture. Hammerhead is best at ruler-straight, open-lettered force; Sentient at close, finely tuned detail.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab stands grounded and refined, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. Over many lines it keeps a steady, dignified footing, a calm counterweight to the wobbly, nearly sealed bowls of Jelly Crazies above it.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-erode: Jelly Crazies has bowls that nearly seal shut and no calligraphic thinning, which makes it playful and wobbly, best loud and close up. Erode, a classic serif with a broad open g and a, does the quieter work of editorial text with a gentle ebb and flow.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-hoover: Monoweight strokes and nearly sealed bowls make Jelly Crazies wobbly and playful from the first glance. Hoover, a refined classic serif with a generous entry into the e and compressed ascenders, feels sturdy and open beside it, like a firm handshake after a joke.
gen-dafont-joystix-fs-bespoke-slab: Pure arcade, wide-set and chunky, with Joystix spacing its letters far apart in bold, tight-lined rows. Bespoke Slab's grounded, refined serif is the sturdy partner, with tall lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-bespoke-slab: Friendly, spaced-out, and calipered. Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters apart, and Bespoke Slab, a grounded serif with tall bodies, can take a comfortably generous size to hold its own against that roomy heading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-erode: Erode reads dignified and editorial. Nasalization hums along as a soft, featureless heading with approachable spacing, while the serif body does the finer work with a broad aperture and mild, gently swelling strokes.
